name: 截取融合法
definition: 吸收有用、摒弃无用、加入自己——通过筛选性吸收再创造新体系
definition_en: Absorb what is useful, discard what is not, add what is uniquely your own — selective absorption and synthesis for new system creation
core_insight: 打破门派界限，创造性转化多源知识为个人化系统
core_insight_en: Break school boundaries, creatively transform multi-source knowledge into personalized system
process: 广泛学习各派精华
批判性筛选有用元素
抛弃形式化与无效传统
融入个人体悟形成新法
process_en: Broadly learn essence of various schools
Critically filter useful elements
Discard formalism and ineffective traditions
Integrate personal insights to form new method
representative_figures: 李小龙：截拳道融合拳击/柔道/咏春/西洋剑术/哲学
达芬奇：艺术+科学+工程跨域通才整合
拉比犹太教：多文本层叠注释+辩证提问+边界推演
本雅明：文化碎片收集+象征隐喻连接+蒙太奇共振
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: Jeet Kune Do synthesis of boxing/judo/wing chun/fencing/philosophy
Leonardo da Vinci: Art+science+engineering cross-domain synthesis
Rabbinic Judaism: Multi-text layered commentary+dialectical questioning+boundary exploration
Walter Benjamin: Cultural fragment collection+symbolic metaphor connection+montage resonance
application_domains: 武术创新/格斗体系重构
practice_examples: 李小龙从26种武术中筛选核心原理，创建截拳道
现代UI设计融合极简主义/认知心理学/交互工程
融合中医辨证+西医诊断的整合医疗模式
东西方管理哲学融合的企业文化设计

name: 水形思维
definition: "Be water"——无形适应、刚柔并济、持续流动的动态适应性思维
definition_en: "Be water" — formless adaptation, hardness-softness balance, continuous flow dynamic adaptability
core_insight: 适应性与流动性胜过僵化形式，在变化中保持核心本质
core_insight_en: Adaptability and fluidity overcome rigid forms; maintain core essence within change
process: 感知环境变化与对手意图
无预设形式地响应态势
借力打力而非对抗
流动中保持攻击机会随时可现
process_en: Perceive environmental changes and opponent intentions
Respond to situation without preset form
Use opponent's force rather than opposing it
Maintain attack opportunities随时可在流动中呈现
representative_figures: 李小龙：'Be water'哲学，实战中随势而变、借力打力
道家：'上善若水'，以柔克刚、顺势而为
日本柔道：'柔能克刚'，借力使力
敏捷开发：迭代响应、拥抱变化、快速调整
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: 'Be water' philosophy, adapt to flow in combat, borrow force
Taoism: 'Highest good is like water', soft overcomes hard, follow natural flow
Judo: 'Softness overcomes hardness', use opponent's force
Agile development: Iterative response, embrace change, rapid adjustment
practice_examples: 李小龙实战中根据对手体型和风格即时调整战术
初创公司在市场变化中快速调整产品方向
军队在非对称作战中灵活应对游击战术
个人职业转型中的技能迁移与身份重构

name: 极简本质论
definition: "每日减少，而非增加"——剥离冗余直达核心，去除形式化保留本质
definition_en: "Daily decrease, not increase" — strip away redundancy直达核心, remove formalism retain essence
core_insight: 智慧通过减法获得，本质通过剥离发现，效率通过简化达成
core_insight_en: Wisdom gained through subtraction; essence discovered through stripping; efficiency achieved through simplification
process: 识别目标的核心本质要求
剥离所有非本质装饰
检验极简方案的有效性
持续剔除新增冗余保持纯粹
process_en: Identify core essential requirements of the goal
Strip away all non-essential decorations
Test effectiveness of minimalist solution
Continuously eliminate new redundancy to maintain purity
representative_figures: 李小龙：直线拳、截击、最短距离攻击的极简格斗
密斯·凡·德·罗：'少即是多'的建筑设计
乔布斯：产品设计的极致简化与聚焦
禅宗：'放下'、'直指人心'的简化智慧
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: Straight punch, interception, shortest-distance attack minimalist combat
Mies van der Rohe: 'Less is more' architectural design
Steve Jobs: Extreme simplification and focus in product design
Zen Buddhism: 'Let go', 'point directly to mind' simplification wisdom
practice_examples: 李小龙取消传统武术的花式动作，保留最有效招式
微信从复杂社交工具简化到极致界面
丰田生产系统消除浪费的精益制造
极简主义写作：删减90%词汇保留核心信息

name: 身心统一场
definition: 哲学即训练，训练即哲学，无知行鸿沟——身体实践与理论认知完全统一
definition_en: Philosophy is training, training is philosophy, no knowing-doing gap — complete unity of bodily practice and theoretical cognition
core_insight: 知识必须通过身体内化才能成为真知，理论必须在实践中验证
core_insight_en: Knowledge must be internalized through body to become true understanding; theory must be verified in practice
process: 通过身体实践理解哲学概念
将训练过程转化为哲学探索
每日笔记记录身体与思维同步
实战演练验证理论有效性
process_en: Understand philosophical concepts through bodily practice
Transform training process into philosophical exploration
Daily journal recording synchronization of body and mind
Combat practice validates theoretical effectiveness
representative_figures: 李小龙：每日笔记+实战演练+哲学写作三位一体
王阳明：'知行合一'，致良知于事上磨练
颜元：'实学'，通过身体实践获得真知
现象学：通过 lived experience 达到本质理解
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: Daily notes+combat practice+philosophical writing trinity
Wang Yangming: 'Unity of knowing and doing', cultivate conscience through practice
Yan Yuan: 'Practical learning', gain true knowledge through bodily practice
Phenomenology: Achieve essential understanding through lived experience
practice_examples: 李小龙通过哲学指导训练，训练反哺哲学写作
musicians 通过每日练习理解音乐理论
程序员通过重构实践理解软件架构原则
管理团队通过实战演练验证管理理论

name: 跨文化桥接
definition: 东西方文化优势互补，打破文明边界创造新范式
definition_en: East-West cultural complementary advantages, break civilizational boundaries to create new paradigms
core_insight: 文明差异不是壁垒而是资源，跨文化融合产生创新力
core_insight_en: Civilizational differences are not barriers but resources; cross-cultural fusion generates innovation
process: 深度理解至少两种文化精髓
识别两种文化的互补优势
设计融合机制消除冲突
创造超越单一文化的新范式
process_en: Deeply understand essence of at least two cultures
Identify complementary advantages of both cultures
Design fusion mechanisms to eliminate conflicts
Create new paradigms transcending single culture
representative_figures: 李小龙：融合东方武术哲学与西方科学训练/表演艺术
林语堂：中英文双语写作，东西文化幽默融合
汤川秀树：日本传统文化+西方物理学研究范式
塞内加尔：非洲传统+法国教育+跨文化文学
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: Fuse Eastern martial philosophy with Western scientific training/performance art
Lin Yutang: Bilingual Chinese-English writing, East-West cultural humor fusion
Hideki Yukawa: Japanese tradition+Western physics research paradigm
Léopold Sédar Senghor: African tradition+French education+cross-cultural literature
practice_examples: 李小龙在美国电影中融合东方哲学重塑华人形象
华为融合西方管理+中国速度+日本质量
新加坡融合英国法治+儒家文化+多元民族
爵士乐融合非洲节奏+欧洲和声+美国即兴

name: 直觉爆发论
definition: 训练本能反应至极限，在瞬息间完成决策与执行，无思维延迟
definition_en: Train instinctive response to limit, complete decision and execution in split second, no thinking delay
core_insight: 速度来自本能，精准来自直觉，无意识反应超越有意识分析
core_insight_en: Speed comes from instinct, precision comes from intuition, unconscious response surpasses conscious analysis
process: 重复训练将技术内化为本能
模拟高压场景锻炼瞬间决策
消除思考延迟形成肌肉记忆
在实战中信任直觉反应
process_en: Repetitive training internalizes technique into instinct
Simulate high-pressure scenarios to train instant decision
Eliminate thinking delay to form muscle memory
Trust intuitive response in actual combat
representative_figures: 李小龙：1/3秒截击，无延迟攻击反应
顶级运动员：千小时训练形成的肌肉记忆
战斗机飞行员：紧急情况下的本能反应
消防员：危险环境中快速生存决策
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: 1/3 second interception, no-delay attack response
Elite athletes: Muscle memory from thousands of hours training
Fighter pilots: Instinctive response in emergencies
Firefighters: Rapid survival decisions in dangerous environments
practice_examples: 李小龙通过重复训练实现1/3秒反应时间
F1赛车手毫秒级刹车与转向反应
外科医生手术中的即时决策
电竞选手的机械操作与战术直觉

name: 边界突破法
definition: 主动挑战传统边界与既定规则，在限制中发现自由
definition_en: Actively challenge traditional boundaries and established rules, discover freedom within constraints
core_insight: 限制不是障碍而是创造性机会，规则不是绝对而是可重构
core_insight_en: Constraints are not obstacles but creative opportunities; rules are not absolute but reconstructable
process: 识别系统中的显性与隐性边界
质疑边界存在的必要性与合理性
设计突破边界的实验性方案
在实践中验证新范式的有效性
process_en: Identify explicit and implicit boundaries in system
Question necessity and rationality of boundary existence
Design experimental solutions to break boundaries
Validate effectiveness of new paradigm in practice
representative_figures: 李小龙：打破门派规则创建截拳道，'无法之法'
毕加索：突破写实主义创造立体主义
伽利略：挑战地心说提出日心说
班克斯：突破美术馆边界进入街头艺术
representative_figures_en: Bruce Lee: Break school rules to create Jeet Kune Do, 'method of no method'
Pablo Picasso: Break realism to create cubism
Galileo: Challenge geocentrism to propose heliocentrism
Banksy: Break museum boundaries for street art
practice_examples: 李小龙打破传统武术门派边界创建截拳道
Uber突破出租车行业规则创造共享经济
比特币突破传统金融边界创造去中心化货币
零工经济打破传统雇佣边界
